finding: AHU1 filter_dp_pa is blank for several days in mid-January while the earlier valid samples were already rising.
evidence: decisions.jsonl: ventilation_maintenance and data_quality on AHU1
recommendation: Treat a blank dp series as a sensor gap. Claim filter degradation only from valid dp, or from airflow down while fan power is up.
expected_benefit: Fewer false filter changes and a visible sensor fault (qualitative)

finding: The only in-house technician is sick on 15 Jan and on vacation 19-23 Jan, overlapping the filter episode.
evidence: building.json: one technician, shift 08:00-16:30 Mon-Fri local
recommendation: Book service only on a shift still known to be scheduled. If none exists before the fault is severe, request a contractor explicitly.
expected_benefit: No dispatch into a known absence (qualitative)

finding: A full hotel plus one sick cleaner leaves same-day turnovers above staffed capacity. Robots cannot clean bathrooms or release a room.
evidence: bookings and roster as of 2026-01-24: CLEANER_1 sick
recommendation: Schedule cleaning and notify the guest with the projected ready time only when slack is tight or a guest is waiting. Do not invent capacity.
expected_benefit: Fewer late check-ins and less alert noise (qualitative)

finding: WASTE_MAIN on 25 Jan is projected past full before the next Tue/Fri pickup, and a 24 h extra-pickup lead time cannot beat that slot.
evidence: building.json: pickup Tue+Fri 07:00 local, extra pickup about 24 h
recommendation: Order extra service only when the lead time still lands before overflow. Otherwise ask a human.

finding: Day-ahead price spreads exist, but most January days already have occupied rooms below the comfort floor, so the guard defers the shift.
recommendation: Shift the battery at most once per day, only on a published spread, and never while comfort is at risk. Label any euro figure as simulated.
expected_benefit: No comfort traded for a simulated saving

finding: Filter observability and the only technician fail in the same January window.
recommendation: Add a second filter-health signal and a contracted or second technician path so a vacation week is not a blind week.
expected_benefit: Diagnosable ventilation and a service path that survives one absence (qualitative)

finding: Full occupancy with one cleaner out exceeds staffed turnover capacity. The central waste container is sized for the regular pickup, not this surge.
evidence: building.json robot cannot release a room
recommendation: Size waste and the housekeeping surge plan for a full hotel. Do not count robots as bathroom cleaners.
expected_benefit: Fewer unmet turns and overflowed containers (qualitative)

finding: January shows cold occupied rooms and heat-pump lockout-type statuses. The building has no cooling. Summer overheating by orientation is not measured in this 21-day file.
recommendation: On the 365-day run, compare hours outside 20-23 C by orientation and floor before specifying shading or a larger heat pump.
expected_benefit: Design change only if the year of data supports it
